entries.disposition_reason: Scope statement: identifies rainwater piping as covered by M16; it is not an independent project predicate or numeric control.
General duty to use M16 for design, supervision, materials and execution; operative requirements are implemented at their specific clauses.
Purpose statement (safety, health, comfort, performance and economy), not an independently testable rainwater requirement.
Legal hierarchy context pointing to law and M2; no independent rainwater design calculation or geometry obligation.
Cross-discipline dependency on M21 for special/vital buildings; applicability and compliance remain with the M21 owner module.
Chapter-scope statement for otherwise-uncovered installation provisions, not a standalone control.
Normative-reference policy requiring current referenced standards; concrete product standards remain enforced by material-specific rules and approval provenance.
Conflict-precedence policy favoring M16 text, not a standalone project condition.
Operations/maintenance dependency on M22; detailed rainwater maintenance documentation remains implemented separately.
